name: Popular Co-op Maps (Classic)
summary: Six of the megawads people still run, played cooperatively on Ultra-Violence.

variants.name: Alien Vendetta
variants.tooltip: Thirty-two maps, and the one everyone measures the others against.

variants.name: Scythe
variants.tooltip: Thirty-two short maps that get very hard very fast.

variants.name: Hell Revealed II
variants.tooltip: Thirty-two maps of far too many monsters, which is the point.

variants.name: Ancient Aliens
variants.tooltip: Thirty-two maps in colours Doom was never meant to have.

variants.name: Sunder
variants.tooltip: Twenty-three enormous maps, and enough monsters to fill them.

variants.name: UAC Ultra
variants.tooltip: Twelve maps, and the shortest way through this list.
